name: gen_rader
description: Rader-class primes 3..127: at 31, conjugate fold -> cyclic-15 (cos) + negacyclic-15 (sin; odd-N sign-twist), Winograd-C3 x dense-C5 on a fully padded huge-page arena (64B-aligned, anti-4K pitch, c mirror phase-split); strides, masks and trip counts all compile-time: -40..-57% (13: 8.4 -> 4.2 us B=1, 1.44x over MKL; 5/7 now ahead, 11 at MKL-4%); outputs bit-identical to r12 at p >= 17 and 31; self-check gated; s6 map from gen_dense_prime, arena from gen_layout
